notes: Dost 6.1 — Aap ke phone test ki 6 khamiyon ka fix: (1) Screen control ab asal halat dikhata hai — Accessibility ON ho to wizard, Phone access aur My Phone teeno jagah ON hi ayega, aur setup mein wapas ane par step khud aage barh jata hai. (2) App kholna ab SAMAJH aur ACTION dono se theek: 'WhatsApp business open karna', 'WhatsApp kholo', 'chala do' — har jumla chalega, aur hukum kabhi web search nahi banega (app na mile to Dost poochhega, search nahi karega). (3) App ab HAATH SE khulta hai, dekh kar: Dost home screen par jata hai, app list kholta hai, screen par naam dhoondta hai, scroll karke tap karta hai — har step batata bhi hai. Seedha launch sirf akhri majboori hai, aur phir woh bhi bata kar. (4) Battery wala button ab settings tak le jata hai — 4 raste hain; koi na chale to steps screen par likhe ayenge, button khamosh nahi marega. (5) My Phone ki awaz wali reading ab asal engine se ati hai — '0 awazein' wali ghalat reading dobara nahi ayegi. (6) Har access ke neeche us ke numbered steps bhi hain (OPPO ke hisab se), aur Settings mein 'Speak chat replies aloud' switch saaf likha hai ke chat ke jawab bol kar sunane hain ya nahi — awaz fail ho to wajah chat mein likhi ati hai.
